name: writes-fail
what: Adds nothing: from now on every save to storage fails (load it after a data seed). Reset or "writes-work" ends it.

name: writes-work
what: Adds nothing: saves to storage work again after "writes-fail".

name: load-fails-once
what: Adds nothing: the next load of the habit list (Today or Week) fails, then loads work again, so "Try again" shows the stored habits. Load it after a data seed, e.g. "two-habits".

name: reads-work
what: Adds nothing: clears forced empty/slow/error states and read failures, so loads read storage again.
